name: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: EMS: Strong sector growth; FY27 outlook remains robust on healthy order backlogs
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Coverage revenue rose 47% YoY to INR302b (CPPLUS +90%, SYRMA +74%, AMBER +60%, DIXON +47%, AVALON +37%; KAYNES +4%, DATAPATT -57%). Order inflow was ~INR48.6b and DATAPATT's order book grew 2.5x YoY; aggregate ex-DIXON/AMBER EBITDA margin was 12.3% (flat) despite component shortages and high working capital. AVALON raised FY27 growth guidance to 30%, SYRMA to 40-45% with a 10-10.5% margin, and DIXON kept ~33-34m mobile units (ex Vivo).

unit_economics: Revenue = bill of materials passed through + conversion charge; EBITDA = conversion value - employee and other costs, so margin % falls when component prices rise while per-unit profit holds

price_drivers.why: Industrial EMS (KAYNES, SYRMA, AVALON, CYIENTDLM) re-rate on order growth; DATAPATT's 2.5x order book contrasts with its -57% revenue.
Component shortages lifted working capital in 2QFY27; Kaynes OCF was about -105% of EBITDA in FY26 and drove its de-rating.
Box-build, high-margin verticals (A&D, medical, rail) and PCB/OSAT ramp lift margin; consumer ODM earns 3-9%.
DRAM, NAND and copper inflation raises revenue and cuts margin percent until pass-through lags clear.
Mobile PLI ended Mar-26 and ECMS capex support drives component project economics and timing.

kpis.name: Order book and derived inflow
kpis.definition: Firm orders executable over about 12 months on the company's definition; inflow derived as change in book plus revenue
kpis.formula: inflow = closing order book - opening order book + revenue in period
kpis.why_it_moves_price: All covered companies reported order book growth (DATAPATT 2.5x, SYRMA ~28%, AVALON ~27%, CYIENTDLM ~23% YoY); inflow decides next-year revenue, and Kaynes guidance was dropped after a weak Q4FY26 inflow.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation 'order book' filter (KAYNES, SYRMA, AVALON, CYIENTDLM decks); transcripts; Motilal Oswal results update tables (8 quarters)
kpis.estimate_source: No Bloomberg order-book field; company guidance on calls (AVALON FY27 growth 30%, SYRMA 40-45%) and broker models
kpis.traps: Order-book definitions differ (Avalon 12-14 month rolling releases, Cyient DLM POs only, Kaynes changed definition three times); OSAT/PCB excluded from book.

kpis.name: Organic revenue growth (volume x ASP)
kpis.definition: Revenue growth excluding acquisitions, captive-customer changes and component price pass-through
kpis.formula: reported growth less acquired revenue; consumer: units x ASP
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Headline 47% growth includes Altek-type acquisitions and ASP inflation; KAYNES at +4% and AMBER at +60% show how dispersed true growth is.
kpis.history_source: get_financials quarterly revenue and segments; get_investor_presentation (units, verticals); Motilal Oswal results tables
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg Sales for FY27-FY29; DIXON mobile unit guidance of 33-34m
kpis.traps: Gross vs net (job-work) booking switches; PLI accrual timing; revenue pass-through of memory and copper.

kpis.name: House EBITDA margin (ex other income, ex incentives)
kpis.definition: EBITDA before other income, with operating incentives shown separately
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Aggregate ex-DIXON/AMBER margin held at ~12.3%; MOFSL expects expansion from operating leverage, PCB/OSAT revenue and supply normalisation, with SYRMA targeting 10.5%+ in FY28 and DATAPATT 35-40%.
kpis.history_source: get_financials 5+ years; Motilal Oswal results update tables; get_investor_presentation margin filters
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg EBITDA FY27-FY29; company margin guidance (SYRMA 10-10.5%, DATAPATTNS 35-40%)
kpis.traps: Deck EBITDA includes other income at Dixon and PGEL; Kaynes consumables reclass broke gross margin series; PLI inside EBITDA.

kpis.name: Net working capital days and OCF to EBITDA
kpis.definition: Inventory plus receivables (incl. deferred and contract assets) less payables on TTM revenue, with cash conversion
kpis.formula: (inventory + receivables + contract assets - payables - advances) / revenue x 365; OCF / EBITDA
kpis.why_it_moves_price: MOFSL flags high working capital from component shortages; Kaynes NWC of 163-190 days and negative OCF drove its multiple from 50-60x to ~35x, so cash conversion is the main re-rating variable.
kpis.history_source: get_financials balance sheet and cash flow; get_investor_presentation 'working capital' filter
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; company NWC targets on calls and broker models
kpis.traps: Bases differ (sales vs COGS, average vs year-end); bill discounting and supplier finance sit outside reported debt.

kpis.name: Gross margin / material cost %
kpis.definition: Material cost as % of revenue, read with conversion value per unit
kpis.formula: (revenue - material cost) / revenue; conversion value = revenue - material
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Memory and copper inflation lifts material share (Dixon material 94% of revenue) and cuts margin percent without hurting per-unit profit.
kpis.history_source: get_financials material cost lines; get_investor_presentation gross margin filter
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models only; no consensus gross margin; get_commodity_prices for copper context
kpis.traps: Reclassification of consumables; fixed-price contracts that do not pass through.

kpis.name: Vertical mix and customer concentration
kpis.definition: Revenue by end vertical (industrial, auto, medical, A&D, consumer) and top 1/5/10 customer share
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Mix toward industrial, medical and A&D lifts margin and working capital together; anchor-customer losses hit consumer EMS (Dixon allocated share to a second EMS).
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation vertical-split filter; annual report customer-concentration note
kpis.traps: Kaynes dropped top-1 customer and geography disclosure in FY26; export share has two definitions.

kpis.name: Component project milestones (OSAT, PCB, displays)
kpis.definition: Capex spent, subsidy received, commissioning date and utilisation of OSAT, PCB, display and compressor projects
kpis.formula: reported milestones vs company start dates
kpis.why_it_moves_price: MOFSL expects margin help from PCB/OSAT revenue starting; slippage (Kaynes OSAT/PCB moved to Q3/Q4FY27) and low turns of ~1x make these projects the key SOTP swing.
kpis.history_source: Transcripts and get_qa; get_investor_presentation project slides; get_financials CWIP
kpis.estimate_source: Company commissioning guidance on calls; broker SOTP models
kpis.traps: Subsidies booked as other income inflate project returns; repeated slip history.

kpis.name: PLI/MPMS incentive income retained
kpis.definition: Operating incentive accrued less share passed to brand customers
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Mobile PLI added ~0.6-0.7pp to Dixon margin; its end in Mar-26 and the MPMS scheme (INR625b FY27-31) decide mobile EBITDA.
kpis.history_source: get_financials other operating revenue; get_investor_presentation incentive filter; transcripts
kpis.estimate_source: Company commentary and broker models; no consensus
kpis.traps: Booking differs: Dixon accrues quarterly, PGEL books on sanction a year late, Syrma books net.

valuation_anchor: P/E on 1-2 year forward core EPS (street targets 35-50x), SOTP with PCB/OSAT and metering valued separately
watch_next_quarter: Whether margins expand as MOFSL expects (supply-chain normalisation, PCB/OSAT start) and working capital eases, plus SYRMA 40-45% and AVALON 30% FY27 growth delivery; DATAPATT revenue recovery against its 35-40% margin guide.
